blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — Two motorcycle riders were killed while a back rider was injured in a head-on collision along the Manila North Road in Urdaneta City at around 6 p.m. on Sunday. A 55-year-old motorcycle rider from Nueva Ecija was piloting a Suzuki Raider 150, with a 35-year-old female canteen helper from San Manuel, Pangasinan, when they crashed into a Honda Click 125 driven by a 37-year-old painter from Quezon City. Initial police investigation says the Honda Click allegedly encroached into the opposite lane in an attempt to overtake a vehicle, resulting in a head-on collision with the oncoming Suzuki Raider.
